summary: Deswell Industries, Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the availability of its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine disclosure of audited financial statements with no corporate action, transaction, or event constituting a special situation. The filing contains no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes; it only informs shareholders of the report's availability. As a standard periodic reporting matter, this 6-K does not qualify for any special-situations category.
